definitions.explanation: The basic structure or frame that supports something, such as a building, ship, or conceptual plan.
The basic framework or outline of a plan, story, or concept.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{骨組|ほねぐ}みが{完成|かんせい}した。
examples.english: The framework of the building has been completed.

examples.japanese: {鉄骨|てっこつ}の{骨組|ほねぐ}みが{組|く}み{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The steel framework has been assembled.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{家|いえ}だが、{骨組|ほねぐ}みはしっかりしている。
examples.english: It's an old house, but the framework is solid.

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}の{骨組|ほねぐ}みを{先|さき}に{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I created the outline of my thesis first.

examples.japanese: この{計画|けいかく}の{骨組|ほねぐ}みを{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: Let me explain the basic framework of this plan.

examples.japanese: まず{物語|ものがたり}の{骨組|ほねぐ}みを{考|かんが}えて、それから{細|こま}かい{部分|ぶぶん}を{書|か}いていく。
examples.english: First think about the basic structure of the story, then write the details.

notes:
Compound of {骨|ほね} (bone) + {組|く}み (assembly). Refers to the essential supporting structure — both literally (buildings, ships) and figuratively (plans, stories).

LITERAL USE:
- {建物|たてもの}の{骨組|ほねぐ}み (building framework)
- {鉄骨|てっこつ}の{骨組|ほねぐ}み (steel frame structure)
- {骨組|ほねぐ}みが{組|く}み{上|あ}がる (the frame is assembled)

USAGE:
- {論文|ろんぶん}の{骨組|ほねぐ}み (outline of a thesis)
- {計画|けいかく}の{骨組|ほねぐ}み (framework of a plan)
- {物語|ものがたり}の{骨組|ほねぐ}み (basic structure of a story)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {骨格|こっかく}: skeleton, framework (more formal/technical)
- {枠組|わくぐ}み: framework, scheme (policy/organizational)
- アウトライン: outline (loanword, more casual)
